Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1160); Bosor (i.e. Beor), a Moabite:--Bosor.
BiblicalUsage: Bosor is the Greek form of Beor, the father of Balaam — and it appears once, in Peter's charge against the false teachers. In 2 Peter 2:15 they have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness. One verse, for the prophet who loved the pay.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Balaam's way is still the way of the false teacher: the right way forsaken, for wages.
